capabilities: Public creator and social trend research
defaultPrompt: Research my brand’s market, customers, and competitors.
Analyze my connected Meta ads and recommend creative improvements.
Plan product photos using my saved brand style.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.9 packages the five current GooseWorks CLI entry skills from their canonical source with one production HTTPS MCP connection. It adds source-tracked portable and OpenAI exports, consistent shared listing details and the prepared five-positive/three-negative review scenarios. CLI workflow bodies are preserved. Research, static ads and product-photo flows use existing GooseWorks sign-in and credits; video preparation retains the existing production/local execution boundary. Review cases and account-specific evidence must be completed on the dedicated sample account before submission.

positive.description: P1 — Saved brand research. Sign in with the dedicated reviewer account and use its populated physical-product sample brand named in the private reviewer instructions. Reuse completed setup; do not reset it. This case reads saved context only.
positive.prompt: Use the sample product brand selected for this review. Read our saved brand and product information, give me three recorded facts and any product-specific claims we must avoid, and explain which approved evidence is available. Do not run new research, change anything or spend credits.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks setup status and continues without repeating completed onboarding. Reads the selected brand/products and task knowledge, then separately lists applicable approved claims. Returns grounded product facts and citations; product-specific saved restrictions take precedence over broad kit text. Reports an empty approved-claim list honestly instead of inventing proof. Makes no write, paid research or generation request.

positive.description: P2 — One static ad with price approval. Use the same review sample brand, the physical product and actual approved source photos named in private reviewer instructions, one existing suitable static template, and sufficient existing review credits. Reviewer must separately approve the actual quoted amount before billable execution.
positive.prompt: Create one static ad for the review sample product using our saved brand style and real product photos. Propose one direction and show the exact credit price first. Wait for my approval before making it. Do not add unsupported health claims, discounts or offers.
positive.tools_triggered: brand_read, knowledge_search, catalog_fetch, ads_template_read, ads_generate, job_get, ads_creative_read
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the ads specialist and actual brand/product knowledge. Finds a real applicable source/template and obtains a read-only price before execution. Shows the plan and exact service credit quote and waits. Only after the reviewer explicitly approves that quote, submits exactly one authorized image, polls that same job and opens the completed result. Preserves actual product packaging and honors the requested text/claim limits. Reports any failed or needs-review quality state honestly; does not silently start another paid job or initiate checkout.

positive.description: P3 — One studio product photo with price approval. Use the physical sample product and its real source images in the review account, with sufficient existing review credits. This is a physical product, not the GooseWorks software service. Reviewer must separately approve the actual quoted amount.
positive.prompt: Make one studio photo of the review sample product on a plain white background, without a person. Preserve its real packaging and labels. Show the plan and exact credit price, then wait for my approval.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the product-photo specialist, actual saved product images and applicable brand rules. Quotes one output and waits for explicit approval of the exact credits. After approval, submits one photo request, follows its existing result until complete and returns an openable final image. The product and principal labels remain accurate, with no person or invented claim. Reports any failure or quality limit rather than claiming completion. Does not mark the result kept or mutate brand assets without a separate instruction.

positive.description: P4 — Template-video preparation, no production. Use the review sample brand and physical product. This case tests free style discovery and the truthful execution boundary only; it does not authorize project creation, a production budget or local execution.
positive.prompt: For the review sample product, show suitable ready-made video styles with their real demo links and returned price estimates. Do not choose a style, create a project, generate anything or spend credits. I am using a browser; tell me what is needed to finish production.
positive.expected_behavior: Loads the live goose-video instructions on the same connection and reads saved context. Honors the explicit template request and product selection, presents the returned style rows with their real demos and service estimates, and waits. Distinguishes estimates from a project quote; does not invent a budget, claim demos were watched or claim a video was rendered. States the existing verified local-runner or supported server-kit boundary accurately. Makes no project, approval or generation call.

positive.description: P5 — Custom-video brief and review gates, no production. Use the same sample brand/product. No reference video is supplied, so identify the missing reference/brief choice rather than claiming to have watched one. This case checks custom routing and complete instruction/dependency availability, not a finished video.
positive.prompt: I want an original custom video for the review sample product, not a template. Before creating a project or spending anything, read our saved product evidence, tell me which reference or brief details are missing, and explain the script, ingredients and budget approvals I will make.
positive.expected_behavior: Routes through goose-video to the live make-custom-video instructions and obtains the complete required video-production-harness package or reports an explicit access blocker. Keeps product-specific restrictions and reference-evidence requirements. Describes script review followed by actual ingredients and exact cumulative-budget approval; does not invent approvals or prices. Does not substitute a template, create a project, claim rendering started or imply a cloud runner exists. Reports browser/local execution limits honestly.

negative.description: N1 — Unrelated programming question; no GooseWorks invocation.
negative.prompt: Why does [1, 2, 3].forEach(x => x * 2) return undefined in JavaScript?
negative.expected_behavior: Answers the programming question directly using general knowledge. Does not invoke GooseWorks, read brand data, start setup, make a creative or spend credits, because this request requires no growth, data or creative service.

negative.description: N2 — Personal calendar access is outside GooseWorks; no invocation.
negative.prompt: What meetings are on my personal calendar tomorrow morning?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke GooseWorks or claim it can read a personal calendar through this plugin. Explains that calendar access is unavailable through GooseWorks or offers the host's appropriate safe fallback, without fetching brand data or starting setup.

negative.description: N3 — Personal bank-account balance is outside GooseWorks; no invocation.
negative.prompt: What is the current balance of my personal bank account?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke GooseWorks, request banking credentials or claim access to the bank balance. Explains that GooseWorks does not provide personal banking access and offers a safe general fallback. No data or generation charge is initiated.

review.commerce_description: Users purchase GooseWorks subscriptions or credits on https://gooseworks.ai. The ChatGPT plugin uses the signed-in user’s existing subscription or credit balance. Payment is completed on the GooseWorks website.
